title: Health endpoint probes its own dependencies with timeouts
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the broad 'except Exception' in _run_probe as error swallowing, and the HTTP 200 on a degraded payload as hiding failures. Both are deliberate: a health probe must never crash because a dependency did, every failure is converted into a per-check 'down' entry with the exception type recorded, core dependencies still flip the endpoint to 503, and each probe receives and honours an explicit timeout.
